description: Round 3 of the full-parity phase (escaping family, seeds 9001-9010, 20000 cases): the two mismatch clusters, both accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP") through the escape `\xd` (minimised from esc-9001-1578, 2 raw cases, and esc-9007-1471, 1 raw case). The marked vectors stay marked by design; each control drops the escape and must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".

known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP"; plans/parity-fixes.md, accepted deviations: follow-ups): the escape `\xd` puts a CR byte into a string literal of the compiled PHP (Compiler::string(), TWIG/src/Compiler.php, does not escape it). PHP's scanner counts it as a line break while Compiler counts only LF for getDebugInfo(), so Error::guess() maps the PHP lines after it to a later `// line N` marker. The control without the escape matches.
